title: "The boxes show what was typed here" lives in a ref beside two state strings; make it one named state
evidence: Filed 2026-11-27. widget-src/src/components/HeightField.tsx:27 typedHeightCm is a useRef read at :32 (showsOtherHeight) and cleared at :34 and :39, beside the heightFeet and heightInches state strings. One named state for the US boxes would carry what was typed and where it came from. PR 2247 (US-02 AC11b, merged in batch PR 2250) added the clear at :34.
